steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Electronic systems process information using electronic components: input (sensors), process (logic/programming), output (actuators). | Key Fact: Input sensors convert physical quantities to electrical signals: LDRs (light), thermistors (temperature), potentiometers (position). | Key Fact: Analogue signals vary continuously; digital signals have only two states (high/low, 1/0); ADCs convert analogue to digital. | Key Fact: Logic gates process digital signals: AND (output high only if all inputs high), OR (output high if any input high), NOT (inverts).
